summary: Iteration 53 — Phase 2 complete batch (Templates, Governance, /dev-os slash, Restaurant+BillPay activation). 13/15 new pytest backend tests pass plus all 4 frontend smoke checks. Templates endpoint returns 5 templates with correct ids/shape; GET /templates/{id} returns full brief; 404 on unknown id works. POST /dev-projects with template_id='saas-dashboard' + empty name correctly auto-fills name='My SaaS Dashboard', sets source='template' and template_id. Governance GET returns default policy with 9 agents enabled + 4 rule keys + max_credits_without_approval; PUT persists auto_approve_documentation=true & max_credits=5 (verified via subsequent GET). Auto-approval wiring works — a documentation-flavoured proposal posted while auto_approve_documentation=true comes back status='approved' & approved_by_user='auto'. /dev-os new posts a confirmation ai-system message with the [Open project →] link, /dev-os scan posts the '⚙️ Dev OS scan' system reply with breakdown + drafted proposals, /dev-os bogus is correctly IGNORED (zero ai-system replies). Dashboard + agents smoke endpoints still 200. Frontend: /dev-os hub shows both agents-link + governance-link; /dev-os/governance renders save+max-credits+4 rule toggles+9 agent toggles; /dev-os/new shows two side-by-side 'Choose a template' + 'Import from chat' buttons; clicking Choose Template opens TemplatePicker modal listing all 5 templates; selecting saas-dashboard pre-fills name='My SaaS Dashboard' and shows the brand-coloured template-banner + clear button. ai-employees catalog reports active_count=6 with restaurant_orders + bill_pay both status='active'. BLOCKER: @restaurant + @billpay in-chat dispatch does NOT actually answer in the demo workspace — the dispatcher posts '⚠️ AI Restaurant Order Taking is not active in this workspace. Owners can start a 7-day trial...' because there is no ai_employee_subscriptions doc for those two employee_keys (workspace has cmo/bookkeeper/sales/paralegal only). The catalog says 'active' but the workspace itself isn't subscribed. The review request expected them to behave as 'live chat employees' — needs an auto-subscribe / seed step.

critical.issue: Dispatcher correctly matches the new triggers (EMPLOYEE_TRIGGERS) but db.ai_employee_subscriptions has no doc for restaurant_orders / bill_pay in the demo workspace, so dispatcher posts '⚠️ AI Restaurant Order Taking is not active in this workspace' instead of an actual order/invoice reply. Existing seed only subscribes cmo/sales/paralegal/bookkeeper. Either (a) extend the seed/onboarding to auto-create trial subscriptions for restaurant_orders + bill_pay, or (b) make the dispatcher treat ACTIVE_EMPLOYEES catalog entries as available without an explicit subscription doc.

action_items: Auto-subscribe restaurant_orders + bill_pay employees for the demo workspace (and on workspace creation going forward) — currently they show as catalog-active but the workspace gate (db.ai_employee_subscriptions) blocks the LLM reply with a 'not active in this workspace' notice. Without this, @restaurant / @billpay flows do not work end-to-end for any non-owner-subscribed user, which contradicts the 'activated as live chat employees' promise in the review request.

(Optional, code review) services/dev_os_slash.py _handle_scan uses created_by_agent='dev_os_slash_scan'; routes/dev_os.py POST /scan uses 'recursive_scan'. Two distinct tags is fine but worth documenting so the UI can group them under 'auto-scan' proposals.
critical_code_review_comments: services/dev_os_governance.py should_auto_approve: when proposal['required_approval_level']=='human_required' it short-circuits and blocks doc auto-approval. Currently docs check is FIRST so docs always auto-approve even when LLM returned human_required — which is the desired override but worth a comment.
services/dev_os_templates.py — categories like 'saas/marketplace/internal/mobile/ai' aren't yet surfaced as filters in the picker UI; future enhancement only.

services/dev_os_slash.py emits ai-system messages but bypasses any AI billing gate (check_ai_allowed used by ai_employee_dispatcher). Slash commands consume LLM credits inside generate_proposal — verify per-chat AI billing in chat_ai_settings.py still applies before broad rollout.

success_rate.backend: 87% (13/15 — 2 failures both stem from the same missing-subscription root cause)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run only LLM-heavy paths via http://localhost:8001 — Cloudflare 100s edge timeout still bites on the public URL. Use BASE_URL=http://localhost:8001 for /dev-projects (with template_id, plan still calls Claude), /improvement-proposals, and /dev-os scan paths. ai_employee_subscriptions collection is the gate for @-mention dispatch; after main agent adds the auto-subscribe step, re-run pytest backend/tests/test_iteration53_phase2_complete.py::test_restaurant_orders_in_chat and ::test_billpay_in_chat.
rca of the issue: Catalog vs subscription mismatch. ai_employees_catalog.py marks restaurant_orders + bill_pay as status='active' with system_prompts wired, and EMPLOYEE_TRIGGERS in ai_employee_dispatcher.py includes the @restaurant / @billpay prefixes. BUT _run_employee() in dispatcher gates on db.ai_employee_subscriptions for the (workspace_id, employee_key) pair — and the demo workspace seed never creates those two subscription docs. So matching fires, dispatcher fetches the sub, sees None, posts the 'not active in workspace' sys message instead of running the LLM. Reproduction: POST /api/auth/demo-login → POST /api/chats {type:group,name:'x'} → POST /api/chats/{id}/messages {body:'@restaurant pizza'} → wait 5s → GET messages → see '⚠️ AI Restaurant Order Taking is not active in this workspace'. Mitigation: in services/ai_employee_dispatcher.py either upsert a default trial subscription on first @-mention, or extend the seed/onboarding job to register restaurant_orders + bill_pay as trial subscriptions when they're catalog-active.
